run_uncompress_s2ef_datasets: run the uncompress script to decompress S2EF dataset files from a compressed directory to an output directory
run_read_lzma_single_file: run the read_lzma function to decompress a single lzma compressed file to a specified output path
run_decompress_list_of_files: run the decompress_list_of_files function to decompress a single input-output file pair using lzma
run_get_parser_args: run the get_parser function to create an argparse parser with ipdir, opdir, and num-workers arguments
run_main_parallel_decompress: run the main function to parallel decompress all txt.xz and extxyz.xz files across multiple worker processes
